// P4.164 evasion fixture — a ONE-ARGUMENT adapter before the presence test:
// the zero-argument chain walk stopped at `.map(…)`, so this `.is_none()`
// open-coded the in-force predicate unseen.
pub fn pending(r: &ChatInformRow) -> bool {
    r.permanent || r.consumed_at.as_ref().map(|s| s.len()).is_none()
}
